title: Mead of Troll endurance
content:
# Mead of Troll endurance

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadStrength | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Troll endurance x1 | Duration: 5m | Cooldown: 2m | Other Effect(s): +250.0 carry weight

# Introduction

Mead of Troll endurance is a Swamp-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Troll endurance.

## Recipe

Mead base: Troll endurance is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 2 Trollfish
• 10 Honey
• 1 Powdered dragon eggshells
Six Meads of Troll endurance are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.
The trollfish that are used must be of exactly the same Quality. Different qualities of trollfish will not combine.

## Effect

Consuming it increases player carry weight by 250.0 for 5 minutes.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
